notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986575/e9f0b260c2794280e11796bdf75eeab61bf23758.png[/img]

[h1]Happy Halloween everyone have a great time![/h1]

[b]Content Updates[/b]
[list]
[*]2 new maps
[*]4 new enemys
[*]One new Gun Effect
[*]Your controllers will now vibrate, while shooting for more haptic feedback
[*]Hits on Enemies now have different sound, when hit normal or critical
[*]Some enemies now have a armor values and getting less Damage
[*]Some enemies now have a resistance to different extra damage Types
[*]There Spawn much more enemies earlier on the higher difficultys 
[*]Enemies give more points when they are destroyed further away from you
[/list]

[b]Optimizations and Bugfixes[/b]
[list]
[*]The endboss gets stronger, when you find him a second time
[*]You now have a flying companion in the tutorial Level
[*]Arrows will show you the right direction on the shooting ranges
[*]Cooldowns on guns are now shorter

[/list]

[b]Optimizations and Bugfixes[/b]

notes.title: New Tutorial / New Guntype
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986575/66704a492552483dfdf3d6bf2901e2d7ee8e63eb.png[/img]

[b]New Tutorial[/b]
There is a completely new tutorial and some changes have been made to the first level so that new players can get into the game more easily.

Also, the steps on each level are explained. So hopefully all the main functions are now clearly understandable.

[b]New Guntype[/b]
There are now three different types of guns
[list]
[*]Pistols
[*]Assaultrifles
[*]Shotguns
[/list]
(more will come soon)

tags.feature: There is a completely new tutorial and some changes have been made to the first level so that new players can get into the game more easily.
There are now three different types of guns

notes.title: Revision of the main menu / a new gun type / update for the arcade mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39986575/7ac1b1c63a9677bc5ffde481a5c3aedb6d7c29e8.png[/img][h1]Revision of the main menu[/h1]
[list]
[*]You can now choose directly between the normal and arcade mode
[*]There is now a small screen with details about each mode
[*]Switches now give audio feedback
[/list]

[h1]Changes within the arcade mode[/h1]
[list]
[*]All 11 maps from the normal mode are now playable in the arcade mode
[/list]

[h1]The new gun type: Vampire[/h1]
[list]
[*]Steals life from the enemy on critical hits
[/list]
